command_examples.evaluate: uv run evaluate.py ground_truth.mcap predicted.mcap --output results.json

deviation_table.followup: After commit/push and operational preflight, invoke uv run evaluate.py at the pinned D2E commit on a generated or real MCAP smoke fixture, or update this table with the exact blocker.
deviation_table.local_behavior: Default tests call local ActionBin metrics and do not clone GitHub, load MCAP, contact Hugging Face, MLXP, or D2E data.
deviation_table.official_behavior: Run pinned D2E evaluate.py over ground-truth and predicted MCAP files.
deviation_table.reason: Phase 0 fixture tests must be deterministic and offline; official invocation is reserved for the later real-D2E/MLXP evidence story.

deviation_table.followup: Compare local fixture output against official evaluate.py on the same MCAP fixture once MCAP writer/reader compatibility is available.
deviation_table.local_behavior: Fixture evaluator reports an unsigned population-stddev ratio max(std_gt,std_pred)/min(std_gt,std_pred), with NA for zero/near-zero axis scale.
deviation_table.official_behavior: Use the scale-ratio formula in D2E evaluate.py at the pinned upstream revision for headline reports.
deviation_table.reason: Local tests need a transparent no-dependency formula; real reports must either verify parity against evaluate.py or cite formula differences.

deviation_table.followup: Implement or enable the MCAP writer adapter, then run official evaluate.py or record the exact schema/dependency blocker.
deviation_table.local_behavior: Round-trip fixture wrappers reconstruct canonical events and writer-compatible dictionaries, not serialized MCAP files.
deviation_table.official_behavior: D2E inference/evaluation consumes and emits MCAP files.
deviation_table.reason: MCAP serialization and real OWAMcap schema compatibility are dependency-gated and must be proven in a bounded real-D2E smoke story.

notes: Pinned official D2E reference path; local fixture tests do not clone, download, contact Hugging Face, or invoke MCAP evaluation.
